duas.title: Before Entering the Lavatory
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللّٰهِ ، اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ.
duas.transliteration: Bismi-llāh, allāhumma innī aʿūdhu bika mina-l-khubuthi wa-l-khabā'ith
duas.translation: In the Name of Allah. O Allah, I seek Your protection from the male and female devils.
duas.virtue:
## The Screen from Jinn

Alī b. Abī Tālib (raḍiy Allāhu 'anhu) narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"The screen between the jinn and the nakedness of the children of Ādam when they enter the lavatory is to say: 'In the Name of Allah.'"

*(Tirmidhī 606)*

## Seeking Protection

Anas b. Mālik (raḍiy Allāhu 'anhu) narrated that whenever the Prophet ﷺ went to answer the call of nature, he used to say:

"O Allah, I seek Your protection from the male and female devils."

*(Bukhārī 142, Muslim 375)*

## Waste Areas Are Visited by Jinn

Zayd b. Arqam (raḍiy Allāhu 'anhu) narrated that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"These waste areas are visited (by jinns), so when anyone of you enters, let him say: 'O Allah, I seek Your protection from the male and female devils.'"

*(Abū Dāwūd 6, Ibn Ḥibbān 1408, Ibn Mājah 296)*

duas.title: After Coming Out of the Lavatory
After Completing Wuḍu #1
duas.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللّٰهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ ، وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ ورَسُوْلُهُ ، اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ التَّوَّابِيْنَ ، وَاجْعَلْنِيْ مِنَ المُتَطَهِّرِيْنَ.
duas.transliteration: Ash-hadu al-lā ilāha illā-llāhu waḥdahū lā sharīka lah, wa ash-hadu anna Muḥammadan ʿabduhu wa rasūluh. Allāhumma-j-ʿalnī mina-t-tawwābīn, wa-j-ʿalnī mina-l-mutaṭahhirīn.
duas.translation: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah. He is Alone and He has no partner whatsoever. And I bear witness that Muhammad ﷺ is His slave and His Messenger. O Allah, make me amongst the repentant, and make me amongst those who purify themselves.
duas.virtue:
## Hadith
The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

**"Whoever perfects his wudhū and then says [the above], the eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him. He may enter through whichever one he wishes."

*(Tirmidhī 55)***

duas.title: After Completing Wuḍu #2
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَكَ اللّٰهُمَّ وَبِحَمْدِكَ ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَّا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ ، أَسْتَغْفِرُكَ وأَتُوْبُ إِلَيْكَ.
duas.transliteration: Subḥanaka-llāhumma wa bi ḥamdik, ash-hadu al-lā ilāha illā Ant, astaghfiruka wa atūbu ilayk.
duas.translation: You are free from imperfection, O Allah, and all praise is to You. I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance.
duas.virtue:
## Hadith

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:

"Whosoever does wudhū and says [the above], it will be recorded in a parchment and then sealed with a seal which will not be broken till the Day of Judgement."

*(Nasā'ī in ʿAmal al-Yawm wa-l-Laylah 81, al-Ṭabarānī in al-Duʿā' 389)*
